soldier: The soldier has the head capsule brown tinged with red, mandibles blackish brown, labrum and antennae yellowish brown, pronotum deep yellowish brown, abdomen pale yellow, the posterior half of the tenth abdominal tergite more strongly sclerotised and darker, legs pale yellow. Head cylindrical, the sides parallel, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded. In profile the dorsal angle of the frons strongly sclerotised and raised, the frontal slope about 45 degrees, the frontal surface with a shallow V-shaped depression, several shallow transverse striae in front of the frons, the Y-shaped suture faintly visible. Compound eyes faintly discernible, their distance to the antennal socket less than the transverse diameter of the compound eye. Labrum short and square, mandibles short and stout, their tips rather curved, the left mandible less than half as long as the head capsule. Antennae with 12 segments. The broad anterior part of the postmentum nearly square, situated before the midpoint, the waist region behind the midpoint, the middle of the sides parallel and then expanding backwards, the posterior margin nearly straight. Pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior margin shallowly concave without a median notch, the lateral margins gently oblique backwards, the middle of the posterior margin with a shallow notch, the median line paler.
